With the good reviews, I had my expectation high & was excited to invite my family over to celebrate my son’s bday. I ended up feeling bad and very sorry for them to experience such troubles. Also imagine the frustation having to call for help every few hours and had staff in and out.

The staff was kind and very helpful but the hotel says it is "luxurious" but is not luxurious at all:
- No hot water during our 4 days of presence. We made several complaints and the staff made us believe that they had brought a plumber: a lie (not the only one). Expect cold showers throughout your stay.
- On our 2nd day the cleaning was not done. We learned that we had to ask the staff, something that was not specified to us.
- The rooms are small and the deckchairs are glued to those of the neighbors.
- The food is not good and expensive.
- The hotel made us believe that they had planned a taxi to see the sunset, we waited more than 30 minutes in vain. We ended up walking there.
- The rates offered by the hotel for certain activities are cheaper elsewhere.

Ulasan:
The room felt outdated, with a noisy bed and a straw roof that let in bird sounds, so light sleepers beware. The shower’s spray setting was either scalding hot or cold, with hot lasting only 1-2 minutes. Breakfast was disappointing—omelets and sandwiches were far from the photos and barely edible.
The biggest issue was the rental scooter breaking down. The host blamed me, claiming the road wasn’t suitable, but I saw dozens scooters there. The scooter wouldn’t turn on, despite working fine the previous day. The host sent a Tow truck to pick us up but later demanded I pay 250KR for towing and 150KR for repairs. After arguing, I paid the towing fee to avoid haggling but ended up still missing a snorkeling trip due to him demanding I pay for these fees, which ruined my last day!, but I also shouldn’t have had to pay anything.
The location is walkable to beautiful Kelingking Beach, which drew us here, but I wouldn’t stay again. Skip the scooters and eat elsewhere if you decide to stay.

Ulasan:
Disappointing value for money & poor communication
Unfortunately, we were very disappointed with us. Communication was bad – we were promised an inclusive breakfast and afterwards they wanted to charge for half the breakfast. The food was of inferior quality, overpriced and the portions were much too small. We were also not satisfied with the surroundings. There were no good restaurants or places to stay longer except the famous Kelingking view point.
The organization of our speedboat tour was also chaotic: The contact person was rude, did not help with the luggage and booked us on much later trips without agreement. Overall, you had the feeling that it was more about the money than the service. Unfortunately not recommended!

Ulasan: Location is perfect for those who want to be in 2 min walking distance from Kelingking Beach! Prime location for the activity. We were able to check it out for a gorgeous sunset and beat the crowd in the morning for the sunrise. The area itself is very rural, make sure to bring cash!!! To our surprise there was a money exchange booth by the beach that accepted cash only for exchange which saved us. The hotel was very peaceful and quiet. Do not expect much from the area as it is very rural and limited with regard to a lot of things to do, other than see Kelingking. Enough home-run cafes. The AirBnb itself served the purpose, however the sheets could have been fresher and the hot water ran for about 2 min. Other than that we think it was a good choice and we enjoyed Kelingking to the fullest.

Ulasan: Great place to stay if you are wanting to visit Kelingking beach. About a 5 minute walk to the beach overlook. From Banjar Nyuh harbor it’s a 45 minute scooter ride, half on rough dirt roads with extreme potholes (not a fun ride). The place was clean, worth what we paid for. There is pool construction during the day so be aware of that. The host was super responsive and helped with us booking all our fast boat rides which made things easy for us. I personally would not spend more than two nights here because of lack of access to things. Minimal and mid-restaurants. Don’t go to diamond beach, you cannot even swim and a tourist trap. But if you do, do NOT pay for anything (parking, ticket). It’s all a scam. Also do not eat the included breakfast at this accommodation. It’s not good (no offense). We enjoyed “Melt Cafe” about 5 minutes up the road. Also we recommend (if you are fit) to head down to Kelingking beach for sunset and a swim (be careful swimming!). Thank you for the stay!
